### Vital Farms to Report First Quarter 2026 Financial Results on May 7, 2026


April 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/845857233/files/doc_news/Vital-Farms-to-Report-First-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-on-May-7-2026-2026.pdf)


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL), a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide, will report financial results for the first quarter ended March 29, 2026, on Thursday, May 7, 2026, before market open.


Vital Farms will host a conference call and webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET on the same day to discuss the results. To participate in the conference call via phone, participants may register for the call[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F369106515%3Fpwd%3DmuYqfz7W&esheet=54519067&newsitemid=20260423817167&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=1&md5=c10c944531fff9b1c3153d40a890b1e2) to receive dial-in details and a unique pin.


Alternatively, participants may access the live webcast on the Vital Farms Investor Relations website at[https://investors.vitalfarms.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.globenewswire.com%2FTracker%3Fdata%3DQu8W9gXW-dB0MxBoiI4oN99i7piaoznoKiS2fnDJJHjKwRiHX_at6yVHNNFi6pU40bqGrwPWrU1a_alVCtGTo8rOkoE9-d3_bmwii0vFnaSXxLh6ZYbCSOVtvNhFMIo3&esheet=54519067&newsitemid=20260423817167&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.vitalfarms.com&index=2&md5=43ae9df167d197107e37e045b696cfe0) under “Events.” The webcast will be archived for 30 days.


**About Vital Farms**


Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL) is a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide. Started on a single farm in Austin, Texas, in 2007, Vital Farms is now a national consumer brand that works with 600 small farms and is the leading U.S. brand of pasture-raised eggs by retail dollar sales. Vital Farms’ ethics are exemplified by its focus on the humane treatment of farm animals and sustainable farming practices. In addition, as a Delaware public benefit corporation, Vital Farms prioritizes the long-term benefits of each of its stakeholders, including farmers and suppliers, customers and consumers, communities and the environment, and crew members and stockholders. Vital Farms’ products, including shell eggs, butter, hard-boiled eggs, and liquid whole eggs, are sold in more than 24,000 stores nationwide. Vital Farms pasture-raised eggs can also be found on menus at hundreds of foodservice operators across the country. For more information, visit[https://vitalfarms.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fvitalfarms.com%2F&esheet=54519067&newsitemid=20260423817167&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fvitalfarms.com%2F&index=3&md5=49559d90b6f613212b3bda24109af15a) .
